title: Adacta owns the platform layer with AdInsure, making it a competitor more than a channel
content:
Adacta owns AdInsure, a proprietary insurance platform, which places it in the platform layer rather than beside it. The assessment's conclusion follows directly: it is a competitor more than a channel.

The reasoning is the same one that disqualifies the other product owners in this set. An engagement needs the application layer to be empty, or held by something the partner is willing to displace, and a firm whose commercial identity is its own insurance platform is not that partner. At roughly 218 people in Slovenia it would otherwise be the right size, which is what makes the exclusion structural rather than incidental.

It stays in the record as a competitive reference point for the insurance vertical rather than as a lead to work.
